items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I think my first party I played was with Bubba Roberts on trumpet, his daughter, Gladys played piano, and a guy named, Milton Fletcher -- he was on bass.

ctx.x: Right, Milton Fletcher on bass, and
I played the drum. That was my first gig. I remember I was about 11 years old when I played that party.
